days.description: The best time to visit. Temperatures are comfortable (25–32°C / 77–90°F), low humidity, minimal rain. This is peak tourist season — book accommodation and island tours 2–4 weeks ahead. Prices are 20–40% higher than low season but the weather is worth it.
